text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 棕色窄框墨镜。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: Extract and recreate ONLY one pair of narrow brown-framed sunglasses, WITHOUT any hanging necklace or eyeglass chain from the reference. Single-object product photography, large and centered on pure white background. The reference contains a person wearing clothing; OMIT THE PERSON AND ALL CLOTHING COMPLETELY. Do not recreate the outfit. No other objects, shoes, garment, mannequin, text or collage. Photorealistic material and complete uncropped object. The entire finished image must contain this accessory alone.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
